title: My first project | The Void Crusader. Chapter I
author: Koipse
selftext:
Hello!

I’d like to show you a demo and a trailer for my project. The story of this world has been swirling around in my head for the past 15 years. And it’s only recently that I’ve started bringing it to life.

This trailer is meant to give you a sense of the story’s overall vibe, as well as a hint at what’s to come.

I’d appreciate it if you could test the game or watch the trailer and share your thoughts.

The game was developed using the local engines LLM, Opus, and Fable. All things got around 1 month between from 0 to demo, except story line, because it was prepared long time ago)

Thanks!
